preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
Each of the n lines after the first contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isdigit() or c in '-+' for c in coord) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for coord in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each coordinate in the input is a valid integer (possibly negative).

preconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= 10**9 and abs(int(y)) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each coordinate's absolute value does not exceed 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len({(int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for x, y in [line.split()]}) == n
preconditions.description: All points in the input are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains m points where m is at least n and at most 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= 10**9 and abs(int(y)) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:m+1] for x, y in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: All output points have integer coordinates with absolute values not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((int(x), int(y)) in {(int(xi), int(yi)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for xi, yi in [line.split()]} or (int(x), int(y)) not in {(int(xi), int(yi)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for xi, yi in [line.split()]}) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:m+1] for x, y in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: The output set is a superset of the input points.

postconditions.expression: all(any((int(x1) == int(x2) and int(y1) == int(y2)) or (int(x1) == int(x2)) or (int(y1) == int(y2)) or any((int(x1) <= int(x) <= int(x2) or int(x2) <= int(x) <= int(x1)) and (int(y1) <= int(y) <= int(y2) or int(y2) <= int(y) <= int(y1)) and not ((int(x) == int(x1) and int(y) == int(y1)) or (int(x) == int(x2) and int(y) == int(y2))) for (int(x), int(y)) in points) for (int(x1), int(y1)) in points for (int(x2), int(y2)) in points if (int(x1), int(y1)) != (int(x2), int(y2)))
postconditions.description: For any two points in the output set, at least one of the three conditions is satisfied: they share the same x-coordinate, same y-coordinate, or the rectangle formed by them contains at least one other point in the set (excluding themselves). Here, points is the set of all output points.
